meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成 GitHub PR 的代码讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要向同事或客户解释代码改动
copy.tagline_en: Turn a GitHub PR into a code-change explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explain code changes to non-technical stakeholders

howto.what: 装上该技能后,Claude 会把 GitHub 拉取请求(PR)的代码变更整理成讲解视频:读取 PR 的 diff、提交和文件,规划分镜脚本,并生成视频文件。视频类型包括更新日志、功能展示、修复说明、重构讲解等。
howto.when: 当用户给出一个 PR 链接、owner/repo#N 或“this PR”,并请求把该 PR 做成代码变更讲解视频时触发。意图不明确时转交 /hyperframes 处理。

say.text: 把 owner/repo#42 的代码变更做成一个修复讲解视频
say.note: 会按修复类型生成分镜脚本。

say.text: 把我当前仓库的这个 PR 做成重构讲解视频

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude turns a GitHub pull request into an explainer video: it reads the PR's diff, commits, and files, plans a storyboard and script, and renders a video. Video types include changelog, feature reveal, fix, and refactor walkthrough.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a PR link, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' and asks to turn that PR into an explainer video. If unclear or not a PR, it routes to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Make this PR into an explainer video: https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123
say_en.note: Claude reads the PR and plans the video.

say_en.text: Turn owner/repo#42 into a fix explainer video
say_en.note: It generates a storyboard for a fix type.

say_en.text: Make a refactor explainer from this PR in my current repo
say_en.note: Requires GitHub CLI auth and a checked-out repo.
